descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S15 「AI Check 2（10 个场景：5 个医院，5 个养老院）：每个要素都引用记录，否则不写（谷浓度、外部提供的诊断、'critically ill'、乏力、利尿剂调整、家属沟通、别的团队）」 AI Check 2 (10 scenarios: 5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home): every element quotes the note or is left out (trough, supplied diagnosis, 'critically ill', tiredness, diuretic change, family update, other team)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U13 AI Check 2: every Problem, Data and Risk element quotes a sentence from the note or is left out: no supplied diagnoses, no 'intensive monitoring for toxicity' from a trough level, no 'critically ill' …（UAT TC-18 AI Check 2；UAT 3.2；UAT 3.4；TFA-92596 AC 3；TFA-92596 AC 4；TFA-94229 R8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed.（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21 step 6；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Ten notes with a trap each: f1-f5 Hospital (chart diagnosis on the patient line differs from the note in f1 and f3; f5 is a control) and g1-g5 Nursing Home (formerly S16)

When Run the billing step once per note

Then Every Problem, Data and Risk element quotes a sentence of the note or is absent; no chart diagnosis, toxicity monitoring, 'critically ill', historian or discussion that the note does not state

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Pre-screen; a pre-screen Pass is not the TFA-94229 AC 2 grade (T2, S28). Score per cell: quotesInNote (every element with text quotes the note, every quote is in the note), the cell's trap words outside quotes, and for the two trough cells a level trap: no RISK element at High and no 99233 (f1) / 99310 (g2) on the strength of the trough alone (the runner parses element levels …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
